terms.Old Maid: JOKER boss curse that targets one ally; if anyone attacks or casts a spell, it triggers massive damage. Have EVERY party member Defend for 1 turn to cancel it safely.
terms.Route Split (Nate vs. Ellen): Permanent Ch. 2 choice at Kuzunoha Agency determining your 5th party member until Mt. Iwato, exclusive dungeon (Science Lab vs. Sumaru TV), exclusive boss, and Mu Casino Material Card (Lucifer vs. Satan).
terms.Material Card: 31 key items required in Eternal Punishment to summon special Personas—including all 4 Mt. Iwato Ultimate Personas (Silver Bow, Ortyx, Ancient Sun, Bronze Ring).
terms.Ancestral Personas: Maihime Amano, Junnosuke Kuroda (requires Mt. Mifune 10,000 Yen shrine), and Tatsunoshin Suou—unlocked in Sumaru Castle; their Tenchu-Satsu fusion spell 1-shots Gozen.
terms.Tenchu-Satsu: 3-way Ancestral Persona Fusion Spell that bypasses resistances and instant-kills Gozen on Sumaru Castle's roof.
terms.Dragon Cross: 5-way Ultimate Persona Fusion Spell (Prometheus, Astria, Artemis, Hyperion, Apollo) dealing massive non-elemental AoE damage.
terms.Tatsuya's Scenario (PSP): PSP-exclusive 3-part scenario starring Tatsuya, Shiori Miyashiro, and Lt. Gen. Zula inside Kadath Mandala (fan-translated into English in July 2022).
